condition: The poly1d coefficients from legendre/chebyt/chebyu/hermite contain tiny nonzero roundoff values (about 1e-16) in positions that should be exactly zero, for degree 4 and higher.
workaround: Use numpy.polynomial instead, e.g. Hermite.basis(n).convert(kind=Polynomial).coef, which gives exact zeros. You can also zero out the coefficients that are known to be zero yourself.
